title: PAN
section: [ Which documents cannot be verified automatically via DigiLocker for Date of Birth (DoB)?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-20) The following documents are currently not supported by DigiLocker for instant DoB verification:   * Passport   * EPIC / Voter ID Card   * CGHS Card   * Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme Photo Card  [ What should I do if I don’t have a DigiLocker account?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-21) As soon as you select the Aadhaar-based application mode, the system will give you a "Register Now" option. Clicking this will instantly redirect you to the official DigiLocker portal (<https://www.digilocker.gov.in/>) where you can create your account and issue your documents in a few minutes. Once done, you can return to complete your PAN application. [ What if I already have a DigiLocker account?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-22) Simply select "Fetch via DigiLocker". You will fill out your PAN details normally, and when you reach the final document submission page, you will be prompted to log into DigiLocker to pull your chosen document. [ I selected "Driving Licence" on the PAN application page, but I don’t have my Driving Licence issued inside my DigiLocker account. What should I do?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-23) Your DigiLocker document selection must exactly match the choice you made on the PAN application page. If your Passport is not available in your DigiLocker vault, you cannot switch it directly inside the DigiLocker interface. Instead, you must cancel the current fetch process, return to the Protean PAN application screen, select a different valid proof (such as your Driving Licence) from the dropdown list, and then click "Fetch via DigiLocker" again to log in and retrieve that specific document. [ Is it safe to share my documents via DigiLocker?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-24) Yes, completely. DigiLocker is a secure cloud-based platform provided by the Government of India. The platform shares your document data in an encrypted, digitally signed XML format. Protean only accesses the specific document you explicitly give consent to share. [ What happens if the DigiLocker system fails or cannot fetch my document?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-25) If there is a technical error, a network issue, or your document isn't supported, the application will smoothly fall back to the standard manual submission mode. You will be able to scan and upload your documents manually just as before, ensuring your application process isn't lost. [ Will I still get confirmation messages about my application status?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-26) Yes. All standard communication protocols remain exactly the same.
